'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**[[2024 Iranian missile strikes in Pakistan]], [[Operation Marg Bar Sarmachar]], [[2024 Iran–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
***The [[Pakistan Air Force]] launches "precision [[airstrike]]s" on militant targets inside [[Iran]] a day after Iranian [[missile]] strikes in [[Balochistan, Pakistan]], killed two at least two [[civilian]]s. Camps belonging to the [[Baluch Liberation Front]] and [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] are reportedly hit. [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/pakistan-hits-militant-targets-in-iran-day-after-strikes-killed-2-in-balochistan-sources-2490166-2024-01-18 (''India Today'')] [https://www.firstpost.com/world/pakistan-strikes-militant-targets-in-iran-day-after-serious-consequences-warning-13627002.html (First Post)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Ukraine]] says that it struck an [[oil terminal]] in [[Saint Petersburg]], [[Russia]], with a domestic-produced long-range [[drone warfare|drone]], as part of a new campaign against strategic targets inside Russian territory. However, Russia reports that the attack failed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-hits-targets-russia-during-drone-attack-oil-terminal-military-source-2024-01-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Jordanian intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
**[[Jordan]] launches [[airstrike]]s against alleged [[Illegal drug trade|drug traffickers]] in [[Urman, Syria|Arman]], [[Syria]], hitting several buildings and killing ten civilians. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/1/18/at-least-10-civilians-dead-in-suspected-jordanian-air-raids-in-syria (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022–2024 United Kingdom industrial disputes and strikes]]
**The largest [[general strike]] in more than 50 years occurs in [[Northern Ireland]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-67981000 (BBC News)]
*[[India]]n [[Multinational corporation|multinational company]] [[Tata Steel]] announces the closure of both its [[blast furnace]]s in [[Port Talbot]], [[Wales]], with the loss of around 3,000 jobs across the [[United Kingdom]], in what [[trade union]]s are calling a "worst-case scenario" for workers. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-68022901 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Ten people are killed, two are injured and one person is missing due to [[landslide]]s caused by heavy rains in [[Davao de Oro]], [[Philippines]]. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-landslide-davao-de-oro-province-d8e16d07726e76b72c69234b4ff82c8e (AP)]
*Twelve children and two teachers are killed after a boat on a school trip capsized into a lake near [[Vadodara]], [[Gujarat]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-68022869 (BBC)]
*An [[Atlas Air]] cargo [[Boeing 747]]-800 suffers an engine malfunction after takeoff in [[Miami International Airport]], and shortly makes an emergency landing. No injuries were reported.

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Mexico]] and [[Chile]] announce that they have filed a request for the [[International Criminal Court]] to investigate allegations of war crimes committed in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/mexico-chile-seek-international-criminal-court-probe-on-crimes-against-civilians-in-gaza-101705612926618.html (''Hindustan Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Ecuadorian conflict]]
**Two people are arrested for killing [[Prosecutor|public prosecutor]] {{ill|César Suárez (Ecuadorian prosecutor)|es|César Suárez|lt=César Suárez}}. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/latino/ecuadorian-prosecutor-probing-tv-studio-attack-killed-rcna134411 (NBC News)]
*[[Corruption in Singapore]]
**[[Ministry of Transport (Singapore)|Singaporean Transport Minister]] [[S. Iswaran]] resigns both as [[Cabinet of Singapore|cabinet minister]], [[Parliament of Singapore|member of parliament]] of [[West Coast Group Representation Constituency|West Coast GRC]] and as a member of the [[People's Action Party| PAP]] after being charged with 27 counts of [[corruption]] and [[Criminal law of Singapore|receiving gratification as a public servant]] by the [[Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau]] (CPIB). It is considered as the highest-profile graft involving a cabinet minister in 38 years. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/iswaran-charged-corruption-transport-minister-cpib-4054406 (CNA)]
*[[Shakahola Forest incident]]
**Ninety-five people are charged in [[Kenya]] over the deaths by 429 followers of a religious cult in 2023. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/1/18/kenya-cult-leader-charged-with-terrorism-over-starvation-deaths (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Protest]]s and [[riot]]s erupts across [[Comoros]] after incumbent president [[Azali Assoumani]] was declared winner following an election earlier this month. A government minister’s house is [[Arson|set on fire]] and roads are barricated in the capital [[Moroni, Comoros|Moroni]], while protestors are [[tear gas]]sed by police. A person is killed and six more injured. [https://apnews.com/article/comoros-protests-unrest-elections-assoumani-bbea90c144941c0cae2c129c2fee6507 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Government shutdowns in the United States]]
**The [[United States Congress]] approves a stopgap bill to extend the deadline for government funding to March 2024, narrowly avoiding a government shutdown, which would have begun at midnight, January 19. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-congress-scrambles-pass-stopgap-bill-avert-government-shutdown-2024-01-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Commercial Lunar Payload Services]]
**[[Astrobotic]]'s and [[NASA]]'s [[Peregrine Mission One]] [[lunar lander]] is destroyed as it reenters [[Earth]]'s atmosphere over the [[Pacific Ocean]] following the failure of its propulsion system. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-67962397 (BBC News)]
*[[Water on Mars]]
**The [[European Space Agency]] probe ''[[Mars Express]]'' finds huge deposits of dusty [[ice]] beneath the equator of [[Mars]], with the discovery being the largest amount of water ice ever found near the planet's equator. [https://www.space.com/mars-water-ice-equator-frozen-ocean (Space.com)]
